spec.fp: every intermediate is fp32, rounded per operation, nothing fused
spec.lane: x: sign r>>63, exponent 124 + r%5, mantissa (r>>11) & 0x7f; row-major, one draw per lane
spec.logit: fp32 sum_d(q[d]*k[d]) in lane order, times head_dim**-0.5
spec.norm: ss += v*v in lane order; rstd = 1/sqrt(ss/dim + eps); xn = bf16((v*rstd)*(1+w))
spec.prng: splitmix64: s += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15; z=s; z=(z^z>>30)*0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9; z=(z^z>>27)*0x94d049bb133111eb; return z^z>>31
spec.rotate: neox half-split; out = bf16(bf16(xn*c) + bf16(rot*s)) with c/s the bf16 cache row; lanes at or past rotary_dim pass through
spec.weight: w: sign r>>63, exponent 125, mantissa (r>>11) & 0x7f; drawn after every x lane
